item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. A strong replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Monday. It will be windy over the region midweek next week. Another surge of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China over the weekend next week. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region.
